laborLawData.summary: Malaysian law mandates annual leave based on years of service: 8 days for <2 years, 12 days for 2-5 years, and 16 days for ≥5 years of continuous service.

changes: Unused leave expires after 12 months unless otherwise specified
hrImpact: Track years of service for each employee
Pro-rate leave for employees who leave before completing 12 months
Monitor leave usage to prevent expiration
laborLawData.effectiveDateEvidence: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) came into operation June 1, 1957
laborLawData.classificationReason: Employment Act 1955 Section 60E - annual leave entitlement

zh.资格条件: 员工须在每12个月连续服务后获得；如果未满一年离职，应按比例折算
zh.休假天数: 工龄<2年：8天；2年≤工龄<5年：12天；工龄≥5年：16天
zh.薪资支付: 雇主100%支付；基本工资/26天×未休年假天数
zh.备注: 未休年假在次年12个月后自动作废，除非合同另有规定

en.Eligibility: Employee must complete 12 months of continuous service; Pro-rated if leaving before 1 year
en.Entitlement: Tenure <2 years: 8 days; 2≤Tenure<5 years: 12 days; Tenure ≥5 years: 16 days
en.Pay Treatment: Employer pays 100%; Basic salary/26 days × unused leave days
en.Remarks: Unused leave expires after 12 months in the following year, unless contract states otherwise

laborLawData.summary: Malaysian law mandates sick leave based on years of service: 14 days for 1-2 years, 18 days for 2-5 years, and 22 days for 5+ years. Total hospitalization leave capped at 60 days per year.
laborLawData.summaryZh: 马来西亚法律规定病假按工龄计算：1-2年14天，2-5年18天，5+年22天。住院假每年最多60天。
changes: 1-2 years service: 14 days paid sick leave
2-5 years service: 18 days paid sick leave
5+ years service: 22 days paid sick leave
Total hospitalization leave: maximum 60 days per year
hrImpact: Require medical certificate (MC) from registered doctor
MC must be submitted within 48 hours
Track total hospitalization days per year
laborLawData.effectiveDateEvidence: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) came into operation June 1, 1957
laborLawData.classificationReason: Employment Act 1955 Section 60F - sick leave entitlement

zh.资格条件: 依工龄而定；必须由注册医生或牙医开具证明（MC），且必须在48小时内通知雇主
zh.休假天数: 工龄1-2年：14天；工龄2-5年：18天；工龄>5年：22天；长期病假/住院假：最多60天

en.Eligibility: Based on tenure; Must be certified by registered doctor/dentist (MC), must notify employer within 48 hours
en.Entitlement: Tenure 1-2 years: 14 days; Tenure 2-5 years: 18 days; Tenure >5 years: 22 days; Long-term/hospitalization: up to 60 days

laborLawData.summary: The 2022 amendment increased maternity leave to 98 days (from 60 days). Eligibility requires employment for at least 90 days in the 9 months before confinement, and fewer than 5 surviving children.
laborLawData.summaryZh: 2022年修正案将产假从60天增至98天。资格要求分娩前9个月至少就业90天，存活子女少于5名。
changes: Can start 30 days before expected due date
100% pay by employer during leave period
hrImpact: Update maternity leave policy to 98 days
Track eligibility based on employment duration
Plan for temporary coverage during leave
laborLawData.effectiveDateEvidence: Employment (Amendment) Act 2022 [Act A1651] increasing maternity leave to 98 days, effective January 1, 2023 per Gazette P.U. (B) 394/2022
laborLawData.classificationReason: Employment (Amendment) Act 2022 - maternity leave increased to 98 days

zh.资格条件: 分娩前9个月内至少受雇满90天；分娩前4个月内至少受雇满1天；存活子女少于5名
zh.休假天数: 98天连续假期，最早可在预产期前30天开始

en.Eligibility: Employed for at least 90 days in the 9 months before delivery; Employed for at least 1 day in the 4 months before delivery; Fewer than 5 surviving children
en.Entitlement: 98 consecutive days, can start up to 30 days before expected delivery date

laborLawData.summary: The 2022 amendment introduced 7 days of paid paternity leave for married male employees with at least 12 months of service, applicable to the first 5 confinements.
laborLawData.summaryZh: 2022年修正案引入7天带薪陪产假，适用于服务满12个月的已婚男性员工，限前5次分娩。
changes: 7 consecutive days of paternity leave (including rest days and public holidays)
Must notify employer at least 30 days before expected due date
100% pay by employer during leave period
hrImpact: Update paternity leave policy to 7 days
laborLawData.effectiveDateEvidence: Employment (Amendment) Act 2022 [Act A1651] introducing 7 days paid paternity leave, effective January 1, 2023
laborLawData.classificationReason: Employment (Amendment) Act 2022 - 7 days paid paternity leave

zh.资格条件: 仅限已婚男性员工，且在同一雇主处服务满12个月；仅限首5次分娩（无论配偶数量）；需在预产期前至少30天通知雇主
zh.休假天数: 7天连续假期（含休息日和公假）

en.Eligibility: Married male employees only, served 12+ months with same employer; First 5 deliveries only (regardless of number of spouses); Must notify employer at least 30 days before expected delivery
en.Entitlement: 7 consecutive days (including rest days and public holidays)

laborLawData.summary: Weekday overtime is calculated at 1.5x hourly rate (monthly salary / 208 hours). Maximum overtime is 4 hours per day, with total working hours not exceeding 12 hours per day.
laborLawData.summaryZh: 工作日加班按1.5倍时薪计算（月薪/208小时）。每天最多加班4小时，总工作时间不超过12小时。
changes: Total working hours (including OT) must not exceed 12 hours per day
hrImpact: Ensure compliance with daily hour limits
laborLawData.effectiveDateEvidence: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) came into operation June 1, 1957
laborLawData.classificationReason: Employment Act 1955 Section 60A - weekday overtime at 1.5x rate

zh.加班上限: 每日加班不超过4小时（含工时总计不超12小时）；104小时/月
zh.适用范围: 月薪RM4,000及以下的员工强制适用；月薪超过RM4,000除非合同另有规定

en.Calculation Rules: Hourly wage = Monthly salary/208; 1.5x hourly rate
en.Maximum Limits: Max 4 hours OT per day (total max 12 hours); 104 hours/month
en.Scope: Mandatory for employees earning ≤RM4,000/month; For >RM4,000, only if contract specifies

laborLawData.summary: Weekend overtime is calculated on top of normal pay: 0.5x daily rate for first 4 hours, 1x daily rate for next 4 hours, and 2x hourly rate for hours beyond 8.
laborLawData.summaryZh: 周末加班在正常工资基础上额外支付：前4小时0.5倍日薪，4-8小时1倍日薪，8小时后2倍时薪。
changes: First 4 hours: 0.5x daily rate (0.5 * monthly salary / 26)
Beyond 8 hours: 2x hourly rate (2 * monthly salary / 208)
hrImpact: Track rest day work separately from weekday overtime
Ensure rest day work is voluntary unless emergency
laborLawData.effectiveDateEvidence: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) came into operation June 1, 1957
laborLawData.classificationReason: Employment Act 1955 Section 60A - rest day overtime at 2x rate

zh.计算规则: 4小时内：0.5倍日薪=0.5×月薪/26；4-8小时：1倍日薪；8小时外：2倍时薪=2×月薪/208
zh.备注: 休息日加班费是在月薪基础上额外支付的

en.Calculation Rules: Within 4 hours: 0.5x daily wage = 0.5×Monthly/26; 4-8 hours: 1x daily wage; Beyond 8 hours: 2x hourly rate = 2×Monthly/208
en.Remarks: Rest day OT pay is additional to monthly salary

laborLawData.summary: Public holiday overtime is calculated at 2x daily rate for first 8 hours, and 3x hourly rate for hours beyond 8.
laborLawData.summaryZh: 公共假期加班按2倍日薪计算前8小时，8小时后按3倍时薪计算。
changes: Beyond 8 hours: 3x hourly rate (3 * monthly salary / 208)
hrImpact: Ensure public holiday work is voluntary unless emergency
laborLawData.effectiveDateEvidence: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) came into operation June 1, 1957
laborLawData.classificationReason: Employment Act 1955 Section 60A - public holiday overtime at 3x rate

zh.计算规则: 8小时内：2倍日薪；8小时外：3倍时薪=3×月薪/208

en.Calculation Rules: Within 8 hours: 2x daily wage; Beyond 8 hours: 3x hourly rate = 3×Monthly/208

laborLawData.summary: Employees earning ≤ RM4,000/month are entitled to statutory severance: 10 days' wages for <2 years, 15 days for 2-5 years, and 20 days for 5+ years. Notice period: 4 weeks (<2 years), 6 weeks (2-5 years), 8 weeks (5+ years).
laborLawData.summaryZh: 月薪≤RM4,000的员工享有法定遣散费：<2年10天工资，2-5年15天，5+年20天。通知期：4周（<2年），6周（2-5年），8周（5+年）。
changes: Severance formula: 10/15/20 days' wages based on years of service
Notice period: 4/6/8 weeks based on years of service
Final settlement must be made within 7 days of termination
hrImpact: Calculate severance based on years of service
Provide proper notice or pay in lieu of notice
laborLawData.effectiveDateEvidence: Regulations published as P.U. (A) 278/80 with effect from October 1, 1980
laborLawData.classificationReason: Employment (Termination & Layoff Benefits) Regulations 1980

zh.通知期: 连续服务年限不满2年：4周（28天）；2年≤工龄<5年：6周（42天）；5年及以上：8周（56天）；违纪解雇：无需通知
zh.离职补偿: 月薪≤RM4,000或特定体力劳动岗位：不满2年：10天工资；2年≤工龄<5年：15天工资；5年及以上：20天工资
zh.结算项目: 离职当月薪资、未休年假折现、未使用通知期补偿、离职补偿金
zh.结算时间: 所有款项必须在合同终止之日起7天内结清

en.Notice Period: Tenure <2 years: 4 weeks (28 days); 2≤Tenure<5 years: 6 weeks (42 days); Tenure ≥5 years: 8 weeks (56 days); Misconduct: no notice required
en.Severance Pay: Monthly salary ≤RM4,000 or specific manual labor: <2 years: 10 days; 2≤Tenure<5 years: 15 days; ≥5 years: 20 days
en.Final Pay Components: Final month salary, unused leave payout, notice period compensation, severance pay
en.Settlement Timeline: All payments must be settled within 7 days of contract termination

laborLawData.summary: When employer and employee mutually agree to terminate employment, the employee is entitled to final month's salary, accrued unused annual leave, and any negotiated severance payment.
laborLawData.summaryZh: 雇主和雇员协商解除劳动关系时，员工有权获得最后一个月工资、未休年假和协商遣散费。
hrImpact: Calculate and pay all outstanding amounts
Ensure compliance with notice period requirements
laborLawData.effectiveDateEvidence: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) Sections 12-15 on contract termination, effective June 1, 1957
laborLawData.classificationReason: Employment Act 1955 Section 12-15 - negotiated termination

zh.触发条件: BP与员工协商离职补偿金
zh.结算项目: 离职当月薪资、未休年假折现、协商离职补偿金

en.Final Pay Components: Final month salary, unused leave payout, negotiated severance

laborLawData.summary: When an employee voluntarily resigns, they are entitled to final month's salary and accrued unused annual leave payout.
laborLawData.summaryZh: 员工主动离职时，有权获得最后一个月工资和未休年假折现。
hrImpact: Complete exit procedures within notice period
laborLawData.effectiveDateEvidence: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) came into operation June 1, 1957
laborLawData.classificationReason: Employment Act 1955 - voluntary resignation provisions

zh.结算项目: 离职当月薪资、未休年假折现

en.Final Pay Components: Final month salary, unused leave payout

laborLawData.law: Income Tax Act 1967 – Progressive Tax Rates
laborLawData.summary: Malaysia uses progressive tax rates for tax residents (182+ days in calendar year): 0% for RM0-5,000; 1% for RM5,001-20,000; 3% for RM20,001-35,000; 6% for RM35,001-50,000; 11%/19% for RM50,001-100,000; 25% for RM100,001-400,000; 26%/28% for RM400,001-2,000,000; 30% for >RM2,000,000.
changes: Progressive rates from 0% to 30% based on income brackets
Tax resident status requires 182+ days in Malaysia per calendar year
New expatriates may initially be non-residents
hrImpact: Apply correct tax rate based on annual income
Monitor tax resident status for expatriate employees
Withhold monthly PCB (Potongan Cukai Berjadual) from salary
laborLawData.effectiveDateEvidence: Finance (No. 2) Act 2023 revised progressive tax brackets effective from Year of Assessment 2024 (January 1, 2024)
laborLawData.classificationReason: Income Tax Act 1967 - progressive tax rates for residents

zh.覆盖人群: 税务居民（在一个日历年内在马来西亚境内累计居住满182天）
zh.备注: 在马来西亚境内一个日历年超过182天的为税收居民，未超过的为非税收居民

en.Covered Population: Tax Residents (residing in Malaysia for 182+ days in a calendar year)
en.Remarks: Residing in Malaysia for 182+ days in a calendar year = Tax Resident; otherwise Non-Resident

laborLawData.law: Income Tax Act 1967 – Non-Resident Fixed Tax Rate
laborLawData.summary: Non-residents (less than 182 days in Malaysia) are subject to a flat 30% tax rate on Malaysian-sourced income.
laborLawData.summaryZh: 非税务居民（在马来西亚居住不满182天）按30%固定税率缴纳马来西亚来源收入。
changes: Non-resident status: less than 182 days in Malaysia per calendar year
hrImpact: Identify non-resident employees for tax purposes
Apply flat 30% tax rate for non-residents
Monitor days in Malaysia for tax residency determination
laborLawData.effectiveDateEvidence: Non-resident flat rate of 30% under Income Tax Act 1967 Schedule 1, updated via Finance Acts, effective January 1, 2024
laborLawData.classificationReason: Income Tax Act 1967 - 30% flat rate for non-residents

zh.覆盖人群: 非税务居民（居住不满182天）
